changelog: - **A two-finger pinch keeps what is under your fingers in place.** On the phone, a pinch zoomed about a point above the fingers by the height of the top bar, so the content under them slid away: up when zooming in, down when zooming out, by the whole bar for a 2× pinch. On a touch screen in Pan mode with the left panel open it slid sideways by the panel's width as well. The pinch now zooms about the point between your fingers, at every screen size and in both orientations. Zooming in and out, the zoom limits and moving with one finger are unchanged.
